description: This file contains functions for checking strict fusion in Torch JIT graphs, including validation of fusion guards and detection of unfused operators.

methods.name: isStrictFusion
methods.description: Checks if a given value is part of a strict fusion module.

methods.name: fusionGuardCheck
methods.description: Checks if a symbol corresponds to a fusion guard.

methods.name: collectValuesUsedInGuard
methods.description: Collects nodes used in a fusion guard via DFS.

methods.name: checkForUnfusedOps
methods.description: Checks for unsupported or unfused operators in the graph.

methods.name: CheckStrictFusion
methods.description: Main function to check the entire graph for strict fusion compliance.
